tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground of every screen. Text on it: ink, ink-muted, ink-dim. Screens add three soft glows on top of it (glow-warm, glow-cool, glow-olive).

tokens.name: glow-warm
tokens.usage: Radial glow, top centre of a screen: radial-gradient(70% 45% at 58% 0%, glow-warm, transparent 72%). Decorative only, never behind small text without ink on bg checked.

tokens.name: glow-cool
tokens.usage: Radial glow, left edge at 28-30% height: radial-gradient(60% 40% at 0% 28%, glow-cool, transparent 70%)

tokens.name: glow-olive
tokens.usage: Radial glow, right edge at 62-65% height: radial-gradient(55% 45% at 100% 62%, glow-olive, transparent 70%)

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, the lesson card, ghost buttons. Holds ink and ink-muted at 4.5:1 or better on bg.

tokens.name: surface-dim
tokens.usage: Answer options that are not the correct one or the user's choice after an answer is shown. Text on it: ink-dim.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline around cards and the lesson card. Decorative edge; the content never relies on it alone.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Border of controls: menu button, ghost button, answer options, language and theme switches

tokens.name: border-hover
tokens.usage: Card and menu button border on hover

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, surface, popover. Contrast above 12:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: lead paragraph, card descriptions, counters, mono captions. On bg 7.6:1 (dark), 5.4:1 (light).

tokens.name: ink-dim
tokens.usage: Text of dismissed answer options on surface-dim. 5.8:1 on bg in dark; light value #5f6a7c is derived: 4.8:1 on bg and 5.1:1 on surface-dim

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brand accent: primary button fill, current step pill, onboarding dots, focus. Dark value is from the mockups; the light value is derived (4.5:1 or better on bg) and not yet used in a mockup.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent fills (primary button, selected language or theme switch)

tokens.name: accent-wash
tokens.usage: Highlight behind numbers inside a question (mono, 0.9em)

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Correct answer: border, number badge, label text, completed-correct step pill. Always paired with the word or the check mark. Light value is derived (5.5:1 on bg).

tokens.name: good-wash
tokens.usage: Fill of the correct answer option

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Wrong answer: border, badge, label text, wrong step pill. Always paired with the word or the cross. Light value is derived (6:1 on bg).

tokens.name: bad-wash
tokens.usage: Fill of the wrong answer option and of the feedback panel after a wrong answer

tokens.name: pill-off
tokens.usage: Step pill that is not reached yet; onboarding dot that is not current

tokens.name: tile
tokens.usage: Rounded tile under a topic icon. Dark outline of the icons (icon-outline) needs this light-or-mid ground.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Background of the open menu popover

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Background of formula and example blocks in the feedback panel

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dimming layer behind a Dialog. Covers the whole screen; the dialog sits on top in popover.

tokens.name: icon-blue
tokens.usage: Topic icon fill. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: icon-yellow
tokens.usage: Topic icon fill. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: icon-red
tokens.usage: Topic icon fill. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: icon-green
tokens.usage: Topic icon fill. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: icon-paper
tokens.usage: Topic icon fill for paper and sheets

tokens.name: icon-outline
tokens.usage: 2px outline of every topic icon. Same in both themes.

styles.name: brand
styles.usage: The wordmark top-left on onboarding and home

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Home screen heading. Set with text-wrap: balance.

styles.name: question
styles.usage: Scenario text inside the lesson card

styles.name: question-ask
styles.usage: The question line under the scenario

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Short rounds, tests and progress for each topic
styles.usage: Home subtitle and onboarding body. Colour ink-muted.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Primary button label. Ghost buttons use weight 500.

styles.name: card-desc
styles.sample: Recognise the heuristic and spot violations on screens
styles.usage: Topic card description. Colour ink-muted, no final full stop.

styles.name: counter
styles.usage: Question counter, streak and timer row

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Topic label in the lesson card. Uppercase.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Level and mode tag, right side of the lesson card header. Uppercase.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Hint above the answer options and verdict labels under an option

styles.name: progress
styles.usage: Progress line at the bottom of a topic card

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Formula blocks in the feedback panel

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between step pills

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between answer options; between a feedback title and its icon

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between topic cards; tile-to-label gap in the lesson card header

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between option number and text; card icon column gap is 14px

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Card inner column gap; right padding of a topic card

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Screen side padding; lesson card padding; feedback panel padding

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Screen top padding; space above the question line

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Space below the home subtitle; onboarding vertical rhythm

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Space below the home header row

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Screen bottom padding on home and lesson

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, menu button, number badges, language and theme switches

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Answer options, feedback panel

tokens.name: radius-popover
tokens.usage: Open menu popover

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Topic card, lesson card, 40px lesson icon tile

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: 56px topic icon tile on home

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Onboarding dots

shadow.note: Light surfaces use a faint lift; dark surfaces rely on the border instead.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Topic cards on the light tint theme

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Open menu popover

tokens.name: screen-width
tokens.usage: Design width of every screen

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height of every tappable control; the menu button is 48px

tokens.name: option-height
tokens.usage: Minimum height of an answer option

tokens.name: tile-home
tokens.usage: Topic icon tile on home; icon drawn at 40px

tokens.name: tile-lesson
tokens.usage: Topic icon tile in the lesson card; icon drawn at 30px

tokens.name: pill-height
tokens.usage: Step pill height; onboarding current dot is 28px wide

tokens.name: logo-header
tokens.usage: Logo mark in the screen header (next to the wordmark `brand`). Never below 24px.

tokens.name: logo-share
tokens.usage: Logo mark on the share card

tokens.name: share-card-width
tokens.usage: Width of the PNG shared after a passed test (4:5 ratio, drawn on canvas)

tokens.name: share-card-height
tokens.usage: Height of the shared PNG

tokens.name: progress-bar-height
tokens.usage: Overall progress bar on the My progress card; the 80% threshold mark is a 2px `ink` line 4px taller than the bar on each side. Level bars are 8px.
